difficulty_rule.difficult: broader reach or dependency/architecture uncertainty forecast near the cap
difficulty_rule.moderate: bounded multi-clause change forecast to fit the cap with ordinary uncertainty

finding: No eligible repositories or independently reviewed task contracts exist, so task feasibility is unproved.
selection_procedure: After repository eligibility, independent task designers create contracts without condition labels.
Two blinded experts score module/file reach, acceptance-clause count, dependency reach, and estimated active effort using non-study exemplars only.
Resolve band disagreement before assignment; do not use candidate behavior, elapsed experimental time, or paired results.
Independent reviewers approve oracle-entailment maps before template hash lock.
Freeze exactly two templates per repository x class x band, then hash and randomize.
substitution_control: Pre-randomization replacement requires a versioned prospective amendment and same stratum. After randomization retain ineligibility under frozen rules; never substitute.
